body:
Purpose:
A compact, ad-hoc tracker to run a light weekend/holiday coverage pass for cross-functional touchpoints. Meant for fast handoff and single-pane visibility when we need to make one-off shifts (burst capacity, short quota increases, fallback toggles).

How to use:
- Owners update their row with minimal free text: current status, concrete action, ETA, and risk level.
- If action requires approval, put the approver in the Notes and ping them on Slack (#ops-runbook).
- Use this sheet for the immediate 72-hour window only; archive after the window closes.

Open questions / TODOs:
- Legal approval path for short-term quota bumps (Ravi) — blocked until 2033-03-15.
- Confirm tracing retention tradeoff with product analytics (Emma) — Emma to confirm by 2033-03-16.
- Validate fallback routing for data residency (SRE + Legal) — high priority.

Quick links and references:
- Incident timeline template: CONFLUENCE:https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/OPS/Incident+Template
- Current infra PR: GH:https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/789
- Triage channel: slack:#ops-runbook

Notes to self (Aisha):
- Keep rows terse; aim for single-sentence actions.
- If risk is High, add expected fallback and owner for rollback.
- After weekend, convert this to a short blameless note and move to /company/misc/ops-mini-sprint-rollup and tag relevant owners.
